cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(robot_runtime VERSION 2.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
include(CTest)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
option(ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_MUJOCO "Build the MuJoCo simulation driver" OFF)
option(ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_PYTHON "Build Python simulation bindings" OFF)
add_library(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE)
add_library(robot_runtime::core ALIAS robot_runtime_core)
target_include_directories(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
target_compile_features(robot_runtime_core INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(executor_test tests/executor_test.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(executor_test PRIVATE robot_runtime_core)
  add_test(NAME executor COMMAND executor_test)
endif()
if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_MUJOCO OR ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_PYTHON)
  if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_PYTHON)
    find_package(Python 3.12 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter Development.Module)
  else()
    find_package(Python COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
  endif()
  include(cmake/Mujoco.cmake)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  add_library(robot_runtime_mujoco STATIC src/simulation.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(robot_runtime_mujoco PUBLIC robot_runtime_core mujoco::mujoco Threads::Threads)
endif()
if(ROBOT_RUNTIME_WITH_PYTHON)
  execute_process(COMMAND "${Python_EXECUTABLE}" -m nanobind --cmake_dir OUTPUT_VARIABLE nanobind_DIR OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
  find_package(nanobind CONFIG REQUIRED)
  nanobind_add_module(_native bindings/python/module.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(_native PRIVATE robot_runtime_mujoco)
  set_target_properties(_native PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/python/robot_runtime_native")
  if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(_native PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${MUJOCO_FRAMEWORK_ROOT}" INSTALL_RPATH "@loader_path/../../lib")
    if(MUJOCO_FRAMEWORK_ROOT)
      install(DIRECTORY "${MUJOCO_FRAMEWORK_ROOT}/mujoco.framework" DESTINATION lib)
    endif()
  else()
    set_target_properties(_native PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../../lib")
    if(MUJOCO_LINK_LIBRARY)
      install(FILES "${MUJOCO_LINK_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION lib)
    endif()
  endif()
  install(TARGETS _native LIBRARY DESTINATION python/robot_runtime_native)
endif()
set_target_properties(robot_runtime_core PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME core)
install(TARGETS robot_runtime_core EXPORT robot_runtimeTargets)
install(FILES include/robot_runtime/executor.hpp DESTINATION include/robot_runtime)
install(EXPORT robot_runtimeTargets NAMESPACE robot_runtime:: DESTINATION lib/cmake/robot_runtime)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfig.cmake" "include(\"\${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/robot_runtimeTargets.cmake\")\n")
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/robot_runtimeConfig.cmake" DESTINATION lib/cmake/robot_runtime)
